scientific_interpretation: Atomic movement execution is mechanically established and conservatively accounted. The selected population/ecological outcomes do not provide a robust directional effect under this movement-only mechanism campaign; this is not evidence of navigation, adaptation, resource seeking, or fitness advantage.
